set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=81ee85a6615c3e2fa78390671a1cbb89d8755fbb; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PACKAGE=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; ACTIVITY=$PACKAGE/.DiagnosticProbeActivity; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '')" = "SM-S906B"; CALL_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -dc '0-9'); echo CALL_STATE_BEFORE=$CALL_BEFORE; test "$CALL_BEFORE" = "0"; "$GRADLE" :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon >/tmp/live-probe-refusal-build.log 2>&1; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PACKAGE" rm -f files/realtime-network-smoke.json; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n "$ACTIVITY" --ez run_realtime_live_call_smoke true --el realtime_live_duration_ms 3000 >/tmp/live-probe-refusal-start.log; FOUND=0; OUTPUT=''; for i in $(seq 1 24); do OUTPUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S'); if printf '%s
' "$OUTPUT" | grep -q 'realtime_live_call_smoke=REFUSED'; then FOUND=1; break; fi; sleep 0.25; done; printf '%s
' "$OUTPUT"; test "$FOUND" = "1"; printf '%s
' "$OUTPUT" | grep -q 'reason=cellular_call_not_active'; CALL_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -dc '0-9'); echo CALL_STATE_AFTER=$CALL_AFTER; test "$CALL_AFTER" = "0"; CONFIG_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PACKAGE" ls files/realtime-network-smoke.json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); echo CONFIG_AFTER=${CONFIG_AFTER:-absent}; test -z "$CONFIG_AFTER"; HELPER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PACKAGE:call_media" | tr -d '' || true); echo HELPER_PID_AFTER=${HELPER:-none}; test -z "$HELPER"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo live_probe_offcall_refusal_s22_green=true; echo no_config_consumed_or_created=true; echo no_media_helper_started=true; echo no_cellular_call_made=true
